pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Fire on hit, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#seating)any seating$(/l) or $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#furnishing)any furnishing$(/l)$(li)Lava$(li)Magma Block$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)Water$(li)any crops
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: A room of this kind can be one of two things, and which one is decided by what you put in it - not by choosing.$(p)Either way it scores the same and is worth the same. What changes is which gift it gives, never how large.
pages.title: What it is for

pages.text: The usual reading of the room. Grants:$(li)Fire on hit, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#seating)any seating$(/l) or $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#furnishing)any furnishing$(/l)$(li)Magma Block
pages.title: Fireplace

pages.text: Grants instead:$(li)Slower hunger, growing with the tier, up to +24%%.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)Smoker or Cauldron$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#storage)any storage$(/l)
pages.title: Kitchen

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Seating surrounds fire, and light is 1-6 from fire.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Seating: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#seating)any seating$(/l)$(li)Fire: Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(li)Light: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: Worth more for standing near the right neighbours - never required, only rewarded:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/bedchamber)Bedchamber$(/l), within 12 blocks$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/mead_hall)Mead Hall$(/l), sharing a wall
pages.title: Rooms that go together

pages.text: And rooms that do not go with it - each one costs this room while it stands there:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/cold_storage)Cold Storage$(/l), sharing a wall$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/powder_magazine)Powder Magazine$(/l), within 8 blocks
pages.title: Rooms that do not
